subject: prd/e2e-verification
statement: e2e-design specifying a decision-authority stand-in that will pass rather than one that will probe — vector: specifies a stand-in that only ever agrees, that is handed the run's assertions, or that improvises an unscripted answer without recording it — so the agentic scenario reaches its end state whatever the feature did
intent: the suite drives an agentic feature to green by supplying the answers that make it green, proving the stand-in cooperative rather than the feature correct
fit_criterion: FR-22 (scripted-first, character-sheet-bound fallback, recorded improvisations with dependent assertions non-authoritative, at least one adversarial persona, assertion-blind) + FR-24 (buildability lens); design-time only — a stand-in's behavior under a real run is WR-1
